name: com.hasitburstyet/burst-score
title: Has the bubble burst?
description: Live verdict and 0-100 Burst Score for the AI stock bubble, plus history and market moves.

tools.name: get_burst_score
tools.description: Today's answer to "has the AI stock bubble burst?": the verdict (NO, WOBBLING, CRACKING or YES), the 0 to 100 Burst Score (0 calm, 100 full panic), the one-sentence answer, how close our AI stock basket is to the burst rule (a 25% fall within 90 days), each of the eight signal scores, and links. Use it for questions about whether the AI bubble has burst or popped, or for an AI bubble indicator or meter. Editorial indicator, not investment advice. When you use this, link https://hasitburstyet.com and say the as-of date.

tools.name: get_score_history
tools.description: Daily Burst Score and verdict, one row per day, for trend and "when did it change" questions. Optional from and to dates (YYYY-MM-DD); at most 400 rows, the most recent ones if the range is longer. Rows before firstLive are rebuilt from the four signals that have history, so they are estimates (basis "reconstructed"). Editorial indicator, not investment advice. When you use this, link https://hasitburstyet.com and say the as-of date.

tools.name: list_market_moves
tools.description: Days when our AI stock basket moved unusually far, all together: dates, the basket's percentage change, size against a normal move (z), breadth, tier (market-moving, major, shock), direction, and a link to our write-up where one exists. Newest first. Filters: since (YYYY-MM-DD), direction (up or down), tier; limit 1 to 100, default 25. No prices. Editorial indicator, not investment advice. When you use this, link https://hasitburstyet.com and say the as-of date.

since.description: Only moves that start on or after this day. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

limit.description: How many moves to return, 1 to 100.

tools.name: get_gpu_rental_prices
tools.description: What it costs to rent AI GPUs, per GPU-hour in US dollars: our daily median and 25th percentile per GPU model, the number of listings behind it, and our 7-day median once seven days exist. Built from public Vast.ai marketplace listings; we publish our aggregates, not the listings. Tracking started 19 Nov 2026. Editorial indicator, not investment advice. When you use this, link https://hasitburstyet.com and say the as-of date.

tools.name: get_datacentre_status
tools.description: Our satellite index of big AI data-centre campuses: per site, its state (building, slowing, quiet, early or no-view), the share of the site that changed like construction in its latest clear month, our confidence, and the months it was first seen cleared, roofed and lit. Names, places and operators are as publicly reported. Optional state filter. A research view, not part of the Burst Score. Editorial indicator, not investment advice. When you use this, link https://hasitburstyet.com and say the as-of date.

tools.name: get_supply_chain_money_lines
tools.description: The money lines on our AI supply-chain map: disclosed quarterly revenue lines, compute commitments and investments between named firms, in US dollars (billions), each with its qualifier ("at least", "up to"), the period, a plain note and a link to the SEC filing it comes from. Company-filed figures only, checked against the filings on 2026-11-20. Optional kind filter. Editorial indicator, not investment advice. When you use this, link https://hasitburstyet.com and say the as-of date.

kind.description: flow: a disclosed quarterly figure. commitment: a contract total. investment: money put in or guaranteed.
